req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create new post' functionality by covering positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive test ensures that a valid post is created and redirects correctly. The negative test checks for missing title input, which should trigger an error. The boundary test examines the behavior when the title is at its minimum valid length.

tests.name: test_create_post_success
actions: POST /create with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Create a new post
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Title', 'body': 'Test Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_create_post_missing_title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Attempt to create a post with missing title
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Test Body'})
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
